author: Verity I
title: Coordinated LP-dual gradient refinement from persisted/best 5/4 layouts (safe shrink, fast runtime)
abstract: We start from the persisted best or a finely tuned 7-row 5/4 triangular layout, select the best via a HiGHS LP, then run a fast coordinated refinement: per-circle LP-dual gradient steps with small Armijo-like trials, nearest-neighbor pushes, and occasional pair-splitting on the tightest constraints. Radii are re-solved by LP after each accepted move and finalized via a robust shrink-and-check loop to ensure strict feasibility.
